serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.Face.normal
You: I can’t believe what I just heard. You killed two people?
You: Maybe you didn’t do it yourself, but still. 2 people died because of you.
You: I’m sorry about what happened to you, but it’s not an excuse for what you did! You are fucked up!
You: You are right. I was selfish by trying to force you into being friends. I was stupid! 
You: I thought that you were similar to {f_botName}, but now I realize how far that is from the truth! 
You: You want to be left alone? Fine! We will stop seeing you, but I will tell the cops what you told me! You are too dangerous to be left alone!
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: You still don’t get it, do you?
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: Sure. You can go to the police, but by doing that you would doom both {f_botName} and yourself. 
You: What the hell are you talking about?
Melissa: When they scan my memory module, they will find out that {f_botName} is also a bot. 
You: Wha- {{punch}}
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: You really are a simpleton.
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: As our parting gift, I will explain to you the two choices you have.
Melissa: 1. {{wi}}You pretend that we never met and we never talk to each other ever again. 
Melissa: 2. {{wi}}You smash me to bits right now. In this very alley.
You: W-What is wrong with you... Why would you even say something like this…
Melissa: The choice is yours, but please, make it quick. I have stuff to do.
